Figma for Google Chat
New releaseFigmaCollaborationAccessibilityFigma for Google Chat
New releaseFigmaCollaborationAccessibilityLearn moreThe Figma for Google Workspace add-on now works with Google Chat, so you can stay on top of your Figma updates. View file previews, get notifications for invites and comments, and reply to feedback directly in Google Chat.
New Glass effect updates
New releaseFigmaDesignNew Glass effect updates
New releaseFigmaDesignThe Glass effect is now generally available, with new updates that let you do more with Glass in Figma:
- Add Glass to anything including any object, shape, or text, not just a frame.
- Design Glass with non-uniform corners and precisely round each corner radius.
- Use the Splay property to control how light bends around an object’s edges
- Apply variables to Glass properties to easily connect to your design system.
FigJam diagramming in Claude
New releaseFigJamAICollaborationDiagrammingFigJam diagramming in Claude
New releaseFigJamAICollaborationDiagrammingCheck out our Shortcut article to learn more.Prompt to turn conversations, documents, and images into visual diagrams to break down complexity and visualize the bigger picture.
With the Figma connector for Claude, you can create:
- Flowcharts to map out processes and decision trees
- State diagrams to visualize system states and transitions
- Gantt charts to plan timelines and project schedules
- Sequence diagrams to document interactions and workflows
Once you've generated a diagram you can open it in FigJam to refine it further and share it with your team to collaborate around.
Discovery pipeline update: User prompts now included
UpdateAIAdministrationDiscovery pipeline update: User prompts now included
UpdateAIAdministrationLearn more about Discovery Pipeline for Governance+Discovery pipeline now includes the user-authored portion of prompts in its exported data, on a go-forward basis, including prompts submitted through Make.
More new features in Figma Make
UpdateFigma MakePrototypingMore new features in Figma Make
UpdateFigma MakePrototypingThese updates give you more precision and control when bringing ideas to life in Figma Make:
- Preview changes before they run: Figma Make will return a to-do list for your more complex prompts so you can see, verify, and even edit the plan before it runs
- Point and edit updates: Manually edit text or delete specific elements to quickly fine-tune your prototypes
- New navigation: There's now a new navigation bar where you can route to a specific screen of your prototype
Embed your Figma Make prototypes
UpdateFigmaFigJamFigma SlidesFigma MakeCollaborationMeetings & workshopsPrototypingEmbed your Figma Make prototypes
UpdateFigmaFigJamFigma SlidesFigma MakeCollaborationMeetings & workshopsPrototypingYou can now embed Figma Make prototypes in Figma Design, FigJam, and Figma Slides to discuss, iterate, and align.
* Copy and paste your Figma Make link to embed it
* Click the 'Play' icon to explore and interact with the embed
Embed a Figma Make to:
- Add prototypes to FigJam for alignment meetings. Make abstract ideas tangible to prioritize features and visualize customer journeys.
- Add live interactions to Figma Slides to align your team. Embed a Figma Make to build understanding and quickly gather feedback.
- Add live interactions to design reviews in Figma Design. Embed a Figma Make to interact with prototypes and review designs simultaneously.
Visit the Help Center to learn more about using Make embeds for collaboration and storytelling.
Enterprise key management
UpdateFigmaAdministrationEnterprise key management
UpdateFigmaAdministrationEnterprise Key Management (EKM) allows your organization to encrypt Figma file data with your own AWS Key Management Service (KMS) keys. This provides your organization additional control over data at rest. You can grant, monitor, and revoke Figma’s access to the encryption key at any time.
